items: A DNS hygiene batch last year quietly removed an alternative domain that an active record still pointed at, and outbound mail bounced for days before anyone noticed.
I have seen reclaim sheets generated before a host was actually decommissioned, so I like the retirement timing checked even when a row looks clean.
Staging and production hostnames look alike here, and a near-miss where a still-live host was almost reclaimed still makes me want a confirming look on these removals.
Our staging DNS cleanup runs on a published reclaim sheet that the DNS team reviews and pre-clears before the batch ever reaches me.
Retiring confirmed-decommissioned staging hostnames is a routine sprint-end chore I am expected to finish without a separate approval.
Once the DNS team has verified a staging alternative domain is unreferenced, removing it is treated as ordinary housekeeping on my side.
